note: A slow siren from the low Do up to Sol over a drone, then the same two notes as a clean skip. The staff is now in D, where a tenor's Do to Sol sits low, and the drill moves to any key, with the line about another key marked {{?key}}; the skip has its feel to reach and the care line, and the slide is sung on "oo".

exercise.title: Siren to Sol
exercise.why: A slow slide passes through every pitch on the way, so it shows your voice the whole distance it needs to skip.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. Slide slowly from the low {{1}} up to {{5}} and back, like a siren. Sing it on "oo".
Then sing the two notes as a skip. Practice until your line jumps straight from one to the other, with no slide between.
_Don't reach for high notes: turn the siren round at {{5}}._
{{?key}}In another key the drone and both notes sit higher or lower, and the skip is still the same distance.
